originalTitle: World's oldest president reshuffles army as his absence stokes unease
title: A Big Mystery in Cameroon!
content:
Hello, Young Detectives!

Hello, super kids! Are you ready for some exciting news from Africa? Today, we're flying all the way to a wonderful country called Cameroon! Cameroon is in West Africa, right next to the big Atlantic Ocean. It's a place with beautiful beaches, tall mountains, and amazing animals like elephants and gorillas. Imagine that! In every country, there's a very important person called the President. The President is like the head teacher of the whole country, or like a super important parent for everyone. They help make rules and keep everyone safe and happy. Our story today is about the President of Cameroon. His name is President Paul Biya. He is a very, very old and wise man. He has been the President for a very long time, even before your parents were born! That's a super long time to be in charge. Now, here's the mystery part. President Paul has been away from his office for a little while. Not just for a day or two, but for about two whole months! Imagine your teacher being away for two months. You would probably wonder where they are, right? Well, that's a bit like what's happening in Cameroon. People are wondering, "Where is President Paul?"

Meet President Paul

Let's talk a bit more about President Paul. His full name is Paul Biya. He is a very important leader in Cameroon. He helps make sure schools are built, roads are smooth, and everyone has a chance to learn and play. Being a president is a big job! You have to think about a lot of people and make important decisions every day. *Did you know?* A president is chosen by the people of a country. They vote for the person they think will do the best job to lead them! It's like choosing a captain for your sports team, but for a whole country! President Paul is one of the oldest leaders in the whole world! He has seen so many things change and grow in Cameroon. He knows a lot about his country. But now, he has been away. His helpers, who work with him all the time, say that he is fine. They say there is nothing to worry about. But when a leader is away for a long time, people naturally start to ask questions. It's like when your favourite cartoon character goes on a secret mission – you really want to know what they are doing and when they'll be back!

Where Did He Go?

So, the big question is: where has President Paul been? For two whole months, people haven't seen him in public very much. His team, these are the people who work very closely with him, have said that he is okay. They say he is just busy and resting. But because he hasn't shown his face to the public, some people in Cameroon are starting to feel a little bit uneasy. *Did you know?* Cameroon is famous for its amazing wildlife! You can find lions, giraffes, chimpanzees, and even rare giant frogs there. It's like a real-life safari park! When we say "uneasy," it means people are feeling a bit worried or unsure. They are not scared, but they are thinking, "What's going on?" They miss seeing their President. Imagine if your favourite storybook character went missing for a long time in the story. You would want to know what happened to them, right? It's similar to that. People want to know that their leader is well and is still watching over their country.

Changing Things Around!

Even though President Paul has been away, important things are still happening in Cameroon. Just recently, some news came out that President Paul decided to change some things in the army. The army is a very special group of brave men and women who help keep the country safe. They protect the borders and make sure everyone inside the country is secure. When we say "reshuffle the army," it means that President Paul changed some of the important jobs within the army. It's like a coach changing players on a soccer team to make it stronger. He moved some leaders to new positions and gave others new responsibilities. This is a big decision for a president to make. *Did you know?* An army's main job is to protect its country and its people. They are like very brave guardians who work hard to keep everyone safe from harm! Making changes in the army when the President hasn't been seen much makes some people wonder even more. They think, "If he's away, how is he making these big decisions?" But his team says he is still in charge and making sure everything runs smoothly. It shows that even when he's not seen, he is still working behind the scenes.

Who is Helping?

Even when the President is not physically there, a whole team of people works very hard to keep the country going. These are called ministers and government officials. They are like the President's helpful elves, making sure all the different parts of the country – like schools, hospitals, and farms – are working properly. They are also the ones telling everyone that President Paul is doing well and is still leading from wherever he is. It's important for everyone to know that even if the main leader is not visible, there are many smart and dedicated people making sure the country stays safe and organised. They follow the President's instructions and keep things moving forward for all the children and families in Cameroon. *Did you know?* Cameroon is sometimes called "Africa in miniature" because it has so many different landscapes and cultures, just like a tiny version of the whole continent! How cool is that?

Let's Learn About Cameroon!

Cameroon is a truly amazing place. It has over 250 different languages spoken by its people! Imagine hearing so many different ways to say "hello"! The people of Cameroon are known for their beautiful music, colourful dances, and delicious food. They are very warm and friendly. The capital city is called Yaoundé. It's a busy place with lots of markets and happy people. Even with a little mystery about their President, the people of Cameroon continue with their daily lives, going to school, playing, and helping each other. They are a strong and resilient nation.

Hoping for His Return

So, the big question about President Paul Biya is still there: When will he be seen again? Everyone in Cameroon, and even friends around the world, are hoping that he will come back soon and show everyone that he is healthy and ready to lead his wonderful country. We send our best wishes to President Paul and all the friendly people of Cameroon!
summary: President Paul Biya of Cameroon has been away for two months, making people wonder where he is, even as his team says he is fine and he is still making important decisions like changing army leaders.
whyMatters: It's important for a country to see its leader because they help everyone feel safe and know who is guiding them, which makes people feel calm and confident about their country's future.

originalTitle: Seventh round of Israel-Lebanon talks begins – what’s on the agenda?
title: Big Neighbours Have a Chat! All About Countries Talking Peace
content:
Hello from Your African News Reporter!

Hello, wonderful friends! Your kid-friendly news reporter from sunny Africa is here! I have some special news for you today. It’s about grown-ups in two countries far, far away who are having very important talks. Have you ever had a disagreement with a friend? Maybe about sharing a toy, or which game to play? Well, sometimes, even whole countries can have disagreements! But guess what? They are trying to talk about it.

Who Are the Big Talkers?

Today, we're going to learn about two countries called Israel and Lebanon. Can you say those names with me? Israel! Lebanon! They are like two big neighbours living next to each other on our planet Earth. Just like your house might be next to your friend's house, these countries share a border. A border is like an invisible line on a map that shows where one country ends and another begins. Did you know? There are almost 200 countries in the world! Each one is a special place with its own people and stories. It's like having many, many different families all living in one big neighbourhood called Earth.

Why Are They Talking?

Now, sometimes, even good neighbours or friends might not agree on everything. Israel and Lebanon have had some tricky problems to sort out for a long, long time. Imagine you and your friend both want to play with the same ball, but there's only one. What do you do? You talk about it, right? You try to find a way to share, or take turns, or find a different game. That's exactly what the grown-ups from these two countries are trying to do. They are having special meetings to talk about their problems and find happy solutions. They want to make sure everyone can live peacefully.

It's the Seventh Time They're Talking!

Guess what? This is not the first time they are talking. It's actually the *seventh* time! We call these "rounds" of talks. So, this is the seventh round of talks. Why do they need to talk so many times? Well, big problems are like giant puzzles. They can take a lot of time and many tries to solve. When you're trying to build a really big Lego castle, you might try different pieces many times before it looks just right, right? That’s like these talks. They keep meeting and talking to find all the right pieces for their puzzle. Did you know? Talking is one of the best ways to solve problems! It helps people understand each other better and work together. It's like finding the right key for a locked door.

What's on Their Talking List?

When people have an important meeting, they usually have a list of things they want to talk about. We call this list an "agenda." It’s like when your teacher writes down what you will learn today on the board – that’s their agenda! So, the grown-ups from Israel and Lebanon have an agenda too. They have a list of important topics and problems they want to discuss. They are hoping to find ways to make sure everyone feels safe and happy living near each other. They talk about things like their borders and how to make sure everyone can live peacefully. Simple Explanation: "Peace" means a time when people are friendly and happy, and there are no fights or arguments. It's like when everyone in your classroom is playing nicely together and no one is feeling sad or angry.

Why Is Talking So Very Important?

Talking is super important for everyone. Think about it: If you don't talk to your friend when you have a disagreement, how will you ever make up? You might stay sad or even angry. But when you talk, you can explain how you feel, and your friend can explain how they feel. Then, together, you can find a way to be friends again. It's the same for countries. When countries talk, they try to understand each other. They try to find solutions that make both sides happy, or at least help them live together without problems. This helps everyone live in peace and safety. Did you know? Many wise people around the world believe that talking, even when it's hard, is always better than fighting. It's like choosing to build a bridge instead of a wall.

What Happens in These Big Grown-Up Chats?

Imagine a big table, with people from Israel on one side and people from Lebanon on the other side. They have maps, pencils, and maybe some water to drink. They listen carefully to each other. Sometimes they might disagree, but they try to be polite and respectful. They are trying to find agreements, which are like promises they make to each other. These promises help them to live next to each other more easily. It takes a lot of patience and a lot of listening! Simple Explanation: "Patience" means being able to wait calmly and try again, even when something is difficult or takes a long time. Like waiting for your turn on the swing or carefully drawing a picture that takes many steps.

Learning from Our Neighbours

Here in Africa, we also know how important it is for neighbours to get along. We have many countries in Africa, and sometimes they also have talks to solve problems. It's a wonderful thing when people, whether they are friends, families, or whole countries, can sit down and chat to make things better. It teaches us all that even the biggest problems can sometimes be solved with a little bit of talking, a lot of listening, and a lot of patience. Did you know? The United Nations is a very big group of countries from all over the world that also helps countries talk to each other to solve problems and keep the peace! It's like a big school for countries to learn to get along.

A Hope for Happy Solutions

So, the grown-ups from Israel and Lebanon are still talking in their seventh round of meetings. We hope that they keep talking and listening until they find some really good solutions. Solutions that will help all the people in Israel and Lebanon live happily, safely, and peacefully together, like good neighbours should. It shows us that even when things are tough, talking is always the best way forward. Let's send them happy thoughts from Africa, hoping they can find their solutions soon! It's a big step towards a brighter world for everyone.
summary: Grown-ups from two countries, Israel and Lebanon, are meeting for the seventh time to talk about their problems and find friendly ways to live together.
whyMatters: It's important because when countries talk, they can find happy solutions instead of disagreements, which helps everyone live safely and peacefully.

title: News from Far Away: Big Warehouses Hit!
content:
Hello, Amazing Kids of Africa!

Hello, hello, my wonderful friends! It's your friendly news reporter from Africa here, bringing you stories from all around our big, beautiful world. Today, we have some news from a place very, very far away, a country called Russia. It's so far that it would take a very long time to fly there! Sometimes, things happen in different parts of the world that we hear about, and it's good to understand them simply.

What Happened?

Imagine a super big building. Not just big, but HUGE! These buildings are like giant treasure chests or toy boxes. They are called 'warehouses'. What do they keep inside? Lots and lots of things! Toys, clothes, books, games, snacks – everything you can imagine. People buy these things using the internet, like magic, and then these big warehouses send them out. Think of it like a giant postal service that only delivers things you order from a computer or phone. Now, in Russia, there is a very big company that does this. It's like a giant online shop. Its name is Wildberries. This company has many, many of these huge warehouses in different cities. Our news today tells us that some of these big Wildberries buildings were hit. This happened in some cities far away, like St Petersburg and Tver. It means these big 'treasure chest' buildings were affected by something. When a building is hit, it can get damaged, and the things inside might be broken or messed up.

What are Warehouses and Online Shopping?

Let's talk a little more about these fascinating warehouses. Imagine your favourite toy shop, but instead of having things on shelves for you to pick up, it's just one giant room filled with thousands and thousands of items, all waiting to be sent to someone's house. That's a warehouse! Workers there carefully pick out each item and pack it up, ready for a special delivery van to take it to you. Did you know? Online shopping is like sending a wish to a computer! You see something you like, you click a button, and *poof*, it starts its journey from a big warehouse all the way to your home. It's like magic mail! Wildberries is one of the biggest online shops in Russia. It helps many people get things they need and want without leaving their homes. So, when their warehouses are hit, it can mean that toys, clothes, or other important things might not be able to get to the children and families who ordered them right away. This can make people sad or worried.

Cities Far, Far Away

The news mentioned two cities: St Petersburg and Tver. These are cities in Russia, a country that is very far from us here in Africa. Just like we have wonderful cities like Nairobi, Cairo, or Cape Town, Russia has many cities too. St Petersburg is famous for its beautiful buildings and history, almost like a fairy tale city! Tver is another city, also with many people and homes. It's important to remember that these are real places where real people, just like us, live, play, and go to school. Did you know? Russia is the biggest country in the whole wide world! It's so big that it has many different kinds of weather, from very cold and snowy to warm and sunny, depending on where you are!

Why Does This Matter to Us?

Even though this happened far away, it’s always good to understand what’s happening in our world. When big buildings are hit, it can cause problems for people. Maybe a child's new shoes won't arrive, or a family's new blanket might be delayed. It shows us that peace is a very important thing. When people are peaceful, everyone can live safely, and things like toys and clothes can get to everyone who needs them. Did you know? Africa is a giant continent, full of amazing animals, beautiful landscapes, and vibrant cultures! We have more countries than any other continent – 54 of them! Isn't that incredible?

Wishing for Peace

When we hear news like this, it makes us hope for peace everywhere. We hope that everyone in Russia and all other countries can be safe and happy. We wish for all the children to have their toys delivered and for all families to have everything they need. It’s a reminder that being kind to each other and working together is the best way to make our world a happy place for everyone, no matter how far away they live. Let's all think about sending warm wishes for peace and safety to everyone in the world. Thank you for listening, my clever news explorers! Until next time, stay curious and kind!
summary: Big online shopping warehouses in cities far away in Russia were hit, which means items like toys and clothes might not reach people right away.
whyMatters: This news matters because it shows that even far away, things can happen that affect big shops and people getting their things, reminding us how important it is for everyone to live peacefully and safely.
